description:
Use this when the user wants one item search found, or what was said in a video: "write show notes",
"give me chapters", "what did I say about the giveaway". A transcript is "[m:ss] line" in original-video time,
in pages (metadata.next). Write notes, chapters and titles from it only, never invented timestamps.
Not for: downloading (get_download_link). Free and read only.

id.description: An id from a search result, e.g. "projects:abc123" or "library:abc123"; or "transcript:<project_id>" for the timed transcript, "transcript:<project_id>@<seconds>" to read on from there
